## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem. Example: *"When connecting to controller X, registering signals requires manual node-id resolution because..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how Atlas should behave.

## Industrial / Practical Context
- Target Controller or Protocol: (e.g. Heidenhain iTNC 530, Beckhoff TwinCAT 3)
- Companion Specifications involved: (e.g. OPC 40001 Machinery, OPC 40501 MachineTool, MTConnect)
- Downstream Observability Target: (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, TimescaleDB, InfluxDB)

## Alternative Approaches
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.
